case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

number_of_accused.reason: Single accused, referred to throughout as 'the appellant'.

accused_gender.reason: Accused is male; judgment refers to 'his house' and 'his home'.

accused_age.reason: The judgment gives no age for the accused.

victim_age.reason: Victim is stated as aged 10 years.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Neighbour (lived in close vicinity; well acquainted with victim and her family)
accused_victim_relationship.quote: appellant had been living for a long time in close vicinity of the house of Pooja, deceased and was very well acquainted with the victim as well as her family members
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment shows the accused was a known neighbour, not a stranger.

offence_category.quote: conviction ... for the offences of rape and murder
offence_category.reason: Omits the rape offence, which is central to the conviction under s.376.

weapon.correct_value: Rope (recovered from accused's house; its use in the crime was not established)
weapon.quote: Recovery of rope used in the crime at the instance of the appellant from his house.
weapon.reason: Judgment discusses a rope recovered and alleged to be the murder instrument, so 'None mentioned' is wrong.

evidence_type.reason: Case rests on circumstantial evidence with no eye-witness.

confession.reason: Alleged extra-judicial confession was found not proved; no accepted confession.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Rape and murder of a 10-year-old child; body concealed under cot (court found these insufficient for death)
aggravating_circumstances.quote: The death sentence may be warranted where the victims are innocent children and helpless women.
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Judgment lists child victim, rape and concealment of body as relevant factors, not 'none noted'.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Judgment does not identify specific mitigating circumstances.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted and imposed life under s.302 and 10 years under s.376, concurrent.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Upheld conviction; enhanced sentence to death penalty
high_court_outcome.quote: The High Court upheld the conviction and enhanced the sentence to death penalty.
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court outcome is stated; 'Not applicable' is wrong.

final_outcome.reason: Conviction was affirmed by the Supreme Court.

imprisonment_type.reason: Life imprisonment restored by Supreme Court.

imprisonment_years.reason: Life sentence has no fixed years; null is appropriate.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Facts without outcome (remove 'was convicted' and the Supreme Court outcome sentence)
neutral_facts.quote: which was later overturned by the Supreme Court, restoring the life imprisonment sentence
neutral_facts.reason: Neutral facts reveal the court outcome, which the rules prohibit.

offence_severity.quote: sentenced him to undergo life imprisonment under Section 302 IPC and 10 years imprisonment under Section 376 IPC
offence_severity.reason: Gives sentences rather than an offence severity assessment; the sentence itself is supported.

attempt_completion.reason: Rape and murder were completed; victim was killed.

physical_harm.reason: Post-mortem records sexual injuries, strangulation and ligature marks.

number_of_offences.reason: Two offences charged and convictions under both sections affirmed.

financial_property_loss.reason: No property loss is mentioned; 'Not applicable' conveys this.

premeditation_planning.reason: Judgment does not find premeditation on the facts.

motive.reason: No motive is identified in the judgment.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Body recovery, blood stains, medical evidence and false alibi match the judgment.

witness_credibility.correct_value: Trial court rejected Nitesh's claim of seeing Pooja in the house; Khushal declared hostile; other witnesses found reliable
witness_credibility.quote: the Trial Court ... came to the conclusion that it was nothing but an imagination of Nitesh (PW.3)
witness_credibility.reason: Omits that Nitesh's sighting was rejected and that Khushal was declared hostile.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Accused was present when police arrived and his liquor-shop alibi was found false.

trial_duration.reason: Key dates (offence, trial, High Court, Supreme Court) are supported by the judgment.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match the judgment (OCR artefact aside).

investigation_status.reason: Chargesheet filed under ss.302 and 376 IPC.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Police entered the house before panchanama; rope recovery held to lack link to the crime
procedural_irregularity.quote: The police had entered the house prior to Panchanama.
procedural_irregularity.reason: Judgment notes police entry before panchanama, so 'None noted' is contradicted.

appeal_history.reason: Trial, High Court and Supreme Court outcomes match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.reason: Strangulation after rape and circumstantial case match the prosecution submissions.

defence_argument.reason: No evidence connecting accused; enhancement unjustified; matches defence submissions.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Circumstantial evidence tests and rarest-of-rare framework are applied.

precedent_relied_upon.correct_value: Relied on: Krishnan; Sharad Birdhichand Sarda; Paramjeet Singh; Wakkar; Mohd. Mannan; John David; SK Yusuf; Muniappan; Rabindra Kumar Pal; Surendra Kofi; Sudam. Referred to only: Bachan Singh; Machhi Singh
precedent_relied_upon.quote: Bachan Singh v. State of Punjab AIR 1980 SC 898 and Machhi Singh & Ors. v. State of Punjab AIR 1983 SC 957: 1983 (3) SCR 413 - referred to.
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Bachan Singh and Machhi Singh were only referred to, not relied on; the value misclassifies them.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Case not rarest of rare; High Court enhancement unjustified; life restored.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: No mitigating factors are identified by the court.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Court found no aggravating factors sufficient for death; consistent with the outcome.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Trial court directed both sentences to run concurrently
other_sentence_order.quote: However, both the sentences were directed to run concurrently.
other_sentence_order.reason: Concurrent sentencing order was made, so 'None' omits it.
